name: Bunker
source:
After a childhood friend goes missing, he becomes a "digger" - an explorer of abandoned bunkers, catacombs, and mines. With the support of the missing man's former friends, the protagonist checks out various places. And then one day, a stranger drops the coordinates of a promising bunker...
